changelog:
v2.5.2 — GUARDIAN ALERT REAL FIX:

🎯 ROOT CAUSE FOUND: intruder selfies and location were being captured from a plain background thread. Since Android 9, that's exactly what makes the OS silently block camera access and throttle location — which is why every alert said "camera was blocked" and "location: fixing… (check SMS)".

✅ FIXED: camera + location now run inside a genuine foreground service with proper camera+location privileges — the selfie and GPS fix now actually work.

✅ FIXED: some phones (Samsung included) fired the wrong-password alert 2-3 times for ONE real attempt. Added a de-dup guard so you get exactly one alert per attempt.

✅ FIXED: removed a duplicate, location-less SMS that was doubling every alert.

✅ Location fetch now tries GPS + network together with a longer window for a better chance of a real fix.

Updates in place over v2.5.1, same signing cert.
